description: This file is a Smarty plugin defining the function 'smarty_function_suite_combinescripts' which combines multiple script files into a single script using a script loader. It is part of SuiteCRM's plugin system to optimize script loading.

methods.name: smarty_function_suite_combinescripts
methods.description: Combines multiple script files specified in the 'files' parameter into a single script output using the SuiteScriptLoader.
